send you flying to the other side of the world.
pal:AmaterasuWolf:
Despite its appearance, <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf|/> is extremely sensitive and will flee 
into a cave when spooked.
Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.
pal:AmaterasuWolf_Dark:
Despite its appearance, <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> is 
extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked.
It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.
pal:Anubis:
Once seen as a symbol of nobility, 
and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power.
Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.
pal:BadCatgirl:
Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. 
If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears
and ignore you for two weeks.
pal:Baphomet:
In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory.
What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.
pal:Baphomet_Dark:
It specifically targets baby Pals, taking them back to its domain.
One can only imagine the profound despair
of a parent whose child has been taken away.
pal:Bastet:
Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off.
Some believed these severed tails bring good luck,
but for the innumerable <characterName id=|Bastet|/> who were
poached as a result, they were anything but.
pal:Bastet_Ice:
Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies.
Some believe it is good luck to raise them,
so <characterName id=|Bastet_Ice|/> in captivity are treated with great care.
pal:BerryGoat:
The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed.
It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.
pal:BerryGoat_Dark:
The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions.
The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become.
This is why most <characterName id=|BerryGoat_Dark|/> raised in captivity have never known love.
pal:BirdDragon:
The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a <characterName id=|BirdDragon|/>
are said to cross whole mountain ranges.
In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.
pal:BirdDragon_Ice:
The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a <characterName id=|BirdDragon_Ice|/> 
are said to cross whole mountain ranges.
In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.
pal:BlackCentaur:
Once one with <characterName id=|SaintCentaur|/>. 
Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. 
However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.
pal:BlackFurDragon:
A silent beast born of the abyss. 
Thou shall not stand before the beast. 
Thou shall not heed the beast.
pal:BlackGriffon:
Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason.
Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals,
one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.
pal:BlackMetalDragon:
A savage beast born of the abyss. 
Thou shall not stand before the beast. 
Thou shall not heed the beast.
pal:BlackPuppy:
The black flames are merely warm to the touch, 
but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. 
Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.
pal:BlackPuppy_Ice:
The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, 
but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes.
Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!
pal:BlueDragon:
This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. 
Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. 
This past has left them bitter towards humanity.
pal:BlueDragon_Ice:
This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, 
yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. 
This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, 
leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.
pal:BluePlatypus:
Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. 
It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends 
in a fatal collision.
pal:BluePlatypus_Fire:
With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs.
But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.
pal:BlueSkyDragon:
Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, 
the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.
pal:BlueThunderHorse:
Like <characterName id=|Kirin|/>, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. 
As faith in <characterName id=|Kirin|/> waned, <characterName id=|BlueThunderHorse|/> was deemed the God's true envoy.
Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.
pal:BlueberryFairy:
Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, 
it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles.
However, when encountered at night, 
its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.
pal:Boar:
Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. 
Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.
pal:BrownRabbit:
Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease.
However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.
pal:CactusDoll:
Its spikes react to its emotions.
A dearly cherished <characterName id=|CactusDoll|/> is something one may instinctively want to embrace.
But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.
pal:CactusDoll_Dark:
Its spikes react to its emotions. 
A well-loved <characterName id=|CactusDoll_Dark|/> clings to its owner, 
but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.
pal:CandleGhost:
It was once believed that as the world approached its end, 
the flame would weaken.
Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken,
but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by <characterName id=|CandleGhost|/>.
At least, for now.
pal:CaptainPenguin:
Surprisingly, it is unrelated to <characterName id=|Penguin|/>.
However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, 
for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.
pal:CaptainPenguin_Black:
Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting.
As a result, it lost the affection of <characterName id=|Penguin|/>—
but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: <characterName id=|Penguin_Electric|/>.
pal:Carbunclo:
Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. 
It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases 
where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.
pal:CatBat:
Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. 
Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, 
the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.
pal:CatMage:
With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena.
It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards <characterName id=|FoxMage|/>.
pal:CatMage_Fire:
Due to its upbringing, 
it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. 
This Pal stopped worrying about those details,
and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. 
Not on good terms with <characterName id=|FoxMage_Dark|/>.
pal:CatVampire:
Attacking from the shadows,
this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings.
It's probably best not to know what happens within them,
or why the inside of its wings are stained red.
pal:ChickenPal:
Extremely weak and far too delicious.
It is one of the weakest Pals alongside <characterName id=|SheepBall|/>.
No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.
pal:ClioneTwins: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For <characterName id=|ClioneTwins|/>, companionship is everything.
pal:CloverFairy:
Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads.
Regarded as symbols of good fortune, 
those with more leaves were heavily hunted, 
leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.
pal:ClownRabbit:
A copy it created might quietly replace it, 
leaving even the <characterName id=|ClownRabbit|/> itself unsure whether it is still the original.
pal:ColorfulBird:
A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. 
It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, 
but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.
pal:CowPal:
Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, 
regardless of its gender.
It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.
pal:CubeTurtle:
Those stones on its back are not just cargo. 
Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.
pal:CubeTurtle_Neutral:
Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, 
<characterName id=|CubeTurtle_Neutral|/> will know where they are. 
No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.
pal:CuteButterfly:
Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. 
There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, 
but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, 
putting a stop to them.
pal:CuteFox:
The idol of Palpagos Island.
If you bully a <characterName id=|CuteFox|/>,
you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.
pal:CuteMole:
Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. 
However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, 
leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.
pal:DandelionGirl:
Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories.
Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.
pal:DarkAlien:
Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it.
Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.
- Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.
pal:DarkCrow:
Long ago it freely soared the skies. 
After losing a contest with <characterName id=|Eagle|/>, it abandoned the skies, 
and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.
pal:DarkFlameFox:
It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply 
bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.
pal:DarkMechaDragon:
-Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon|
-Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by <://Error_Code:126DC> years.
-Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol.
-Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data!
pal:DarkMutant:
Some say a beam from a <characterName id=|DarkMutant|/> that has
perfected its technique can tear holes into other dimensions.
It's even believed that certain species of Pals were born from such phenomena.
pal:DarkScorpion:
Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow.
This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them.
Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.
pal:DarkScorpion_Ground:
Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow.
It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass.
Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans.
pal:Deer:
The one who possesses the most impressive antlers 
becomes the leader of the herd.
If their antlers are broken, they become depressed
and leave the herd never to be seen again.
pal:Deer_Ground:
The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader.
Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status.
It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.
pal:DomeArmorDragon:
In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, 
the light within <characterName id=|DomeArmorDragon|/>'s wings was used to send simple flash signals.
pal:DreamDemon:
It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them
an endless stream of happy dreams.
Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.
pal:DrillGame:
A <characterName id=|DrillGame|/> possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it,
ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children's tale, |<characterName id=|DrillGame|/>'s Fable|.
pal:Eagle:
A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. 
It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, 
which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.
pal:ElecCat:
During the dry season,
this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse.
Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation,
even amongst allies.
pal:ElecLion:
The more it moves, the more it heats up and the hair tips increasingly glow brighter.
At its peak, it becomes so dazzling that you risk blindness if you stare at it directly.
pal:ElecLizard:
Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like.
Surely, <characterName id=|ElecLizard|/> must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury.
...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.
pal:ElecPanda:
With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, 
it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner.
For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change 
when wielding a minigun.
pal:ElecPomeranian:
Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked.
Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, 
making bath time together a serious gamble.
pal:ElecSnail:
Tossing an <characterName id=|ElecSnail|/> into the bath for a shock spa 
is considered a traditional health practice.
That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.
pal:ElecSnail_Ground:
Tossing a heated <characterName id=|ElecSnail_Ground|/> into the bath for a scorching spa 
was once a fad of the distant past.
Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.
pal:FairyDragon:
It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests.
Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil,
often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.
pal:FairyDragon_Water:
It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests.
Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions
and is indifferent even after killing someone.
pal:FeatherOstrich:
Take one step forward and forget your doubts.
Take two steps forward and forget your worries.
Take three steps forward and forget your fears.
Face any enemy.
pal:FengyunDeeper:
In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings.
As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were
often seen in works of art.
pal:FengyunDeeper_Electric:
In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of <characterName id=|FengyunDeeper_Electric|/> 
would result in being struck down by lightning. 
As time passes, artworks depicting <characterName id=|FengyunDeeper_Electric|/> became revered as 
charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.
pal:FireKirin:
Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator,
gifting it with astounding stamina.
If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.
pal:FireKirin_Dark:
It burns mysterious dark matter as energy
and expels the remaining particles from its body.
If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.
pal:FlameBambi:
Wild <characterName id=|FlameBambi|/> surprisingly never get sick.
Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch,
is the secret to its eternal health.
pal:FlameBuffalo:
In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly.
The absurd fury in the cries of <characterName id=|FlameBuffalo|/> transformed into a raging inferno,
which has been passed on to this day.
pal:FlowerDinosaur:
A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. 
It rages on and on like an inferno. 
The phrase |step on a <characterName id=|FlowerDinosaur|/>'s tail| has come to mean enraging someone.
pal:FlowerDinosaur_Electric:
Though struck by lightning, it lives on.
The phrase |struck by a <characterName id=|FlowerDinosaur_Electric|/>'s bolt| has come to mean
narrowly escaping death.
pal:FlowerDoll:
A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. 
Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms 
and a new <characterName id=|FlowerDoll|/> is born.
pal:FlowerDoll_Fire:
A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. 
The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, 
allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.
pal:FlowerPrince:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, and for what purpose, <characterName id=|FlowerPrince|/> does not care.
After all, the World Tree knows everything.
Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.
pal:FlowerRabbit:
It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, 
but hay fever has apparently become a problem for 
<characterName id=|FlowerRabbit|/> as of late.
pal:FluffyBird:
Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, 
but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, 
leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.
pal:FlyingManta:
Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. 
Should it find a partner along the way, 
the encounter will mark its journey's end.
pal:FlyingManta_Thunder:
Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner.
But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving <characterName id=|FlyingManta_Thunder|/>,
yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.
pal:FoxExorcist:
It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames.
Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result.
That is why the future of <characterName id=|FoxExorcist|/> is always exceptionally bright!
pal:FoxMage:
With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena.
It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards <characterName id=|CatMage|/>.
pal:FoxMage_Dark:
Due to its upbringing, 
it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough.
This Pal stopped worrying about those details,
and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. 
Not on good terms with <characterName id=|CatMage_Fire|/>.
pal:Ganesha:
Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose,
though some say that it is, in fact, just snot.
This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.
pal:Garm:
Long ago <characterName id=|Garm|/> would hunt alongside humans
but over the years this bond faded.
pal:GhostAnglerfish:
With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness.
The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape 
once spotted by <characterName id=|GhostAnglerFish|/>.
No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home 
safe and sound.
pal:GhostAnglerfish_Fire:
Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey.
Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once 
<characterName id=|GhostAnglerfish_Fire|/> sets its sights on them.
In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.
pal:GhostBeast:
It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death.
If a <characterName id=|GhostBeast|/> has taken a liking to you,
it is safe to assume that is why.
pal:GhostBlackCat:
The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans 
who have raised its kind.
Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on <characterName id=|GhostBlackCat|/>.
pal:GhostDragon:
A new Pal that was only recently discovered.
Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. 
It is no longer bound by anything.
pal:GhostDragon_Fire:
A new Pal that was only recently discovered.
It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature 
leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.
pal:GhostRabbit:
What it carries is its own soul. 
When it falls for someone, 
it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, 
yearning to become one.
pal:GhostRabbit_Grass:
What it carries is its own soul. 
When it falls for someone, 
it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs,
yearning to become one.
pal:GoldenHorse:
During the golden age of alchemy on the island, 
its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold.
In time, a remarkable revelation was made: 
the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.
pal:Gorilla:
It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. 
The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction 
between them is still largely unknown.
pal:Gorilla_Ground:
It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades.
Stronger than <characterName id=|Gorilla|/>, if every <characterName id=|Gorilla_Ground|/>
hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.
pal:GrassGolem:
One entity, two minds.
When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.
pal:GrassGolem_Dark:
One entity, two minds.
They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!
pal:GrassMammoth:
The vegetation on its back varies between individuals.
There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal,
and there are even <characterName id=|GrassMammoth|/> pruning specialists.
pal:GrassMammoth_Ice:
The vegetation on its back varies between individuals.
There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found
still frozen on the back of a <characterName id=|GrassMammoth_Ice|/>.
pal:GrassMinotaur:
The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled.
When the leaf falls on its own, <characterName id=|GrassMinotaur|/> accepts its time has come.
pal:GrassMinotaur_Ice:
Its frozen horn stays solid through its life.
When water begins to drip from this ice,
<characterName id=|GrassMinotaur_Ice|/> feels the chill of its own life slipping away.
pal:GrassPanda:
A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe.
In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once!
It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.
pal:GrassPanda_Electric:
A Pal whose power is truly shocking.
By altering the electrical currents in its body, 
this Pal's been able to overload its own strength.
When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.
pal:GrassRabbitMan:
Land that <characterName id=|GrassRabbitMan|/> has run across becomes extremely fertile,
with thick vegetation growing soon after.
It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.
pal:GrimGirl:
It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart.
Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment.
If caught by <characterName id=|GrimGirl|/>, pray that your head is taken first.
pal:GuardianDog:
It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil.
In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders.
Nowadays, <characterName id=|GuardianDog|/>s are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.
pal:HadesBird:
It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell.
Those who dies from <characterName id=|HadesBird|/>'s lightning
are sure to have their soul sent to the underworld.
pal:HadesBird_Electric:
It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell.
While considered a subspecies of <characterName id=|HadesBird|/>,
there's a theory that suggests <characterName id=|HadesBird_Electric|/>, struck by lightning from hell,
will transform into <characterName id=|HadesBird|/>.
pal:HawkBird:
It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them 
as a surrogate parent. 
Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.
pal:Hedgehog:
It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack.
The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts,
making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.
pal:Hedgehog_Ice:
It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. 
The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air 
and easily pierces through any attacker's body.
pal:HerculesBeetle:
The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is
extremely strong and heat resistant.
Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.
pal:HerculesBeetle_Ground:
The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is
extremely strong and heat resistant.
It doesn't flinch even if a <characterName id=|GrassMammoth|/> steps on it.
pal:HoodGhost:
When it sleeps, it deflates.
When it sleeps, it's no longer there.
A sleeping <characterName id=|HoodGhost|/> cannot exist;
Therefore, <characterName id=|HoodGhost|/> never sleeps.
pal:Horus:
When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, 
burning the entire area to ash.
<characterName id=|Horus|/> breath is known for its pleasing scent.
pal:Horus_Water:
When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area.
More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, 
leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.
pal:Human:
A captured human. On Palpagos Island,
capturing humans in Pal Spheres is considered inhumane.
pal:IceCrocodile:
The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, 
making it a natural fridge when closed. 
Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. 
Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans—
whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.
pal:IceDeer:
Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero.
Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen
and smashed to pieces.
pal:IceFox:
On nights when the aurora is visible,
it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song.
This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.
pal:IceHorse:
Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller.
In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky
and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal winter.
pal:IceHorse_Dark:
Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Night Caller.
In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky
and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.
pal:IceNarwhal:
When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. 
Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, 
it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.
pal:IceNarwhal_Fire:
Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, 
it turned bright red through sheer will.
Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red.
So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.
pal:IceSeal:
Among <characterName id=|IceSeal|/>s, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect.
Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky—
a common sight during territorial season.
Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying <characterName id=|IceSeal|/>s.
pal:IceSeal_Ground:
Among <characterName id=|IceSeal_Ground|/>s, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. 
Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow—
a common sight during particularly competitive seasons.
Traffic forecast: heavy <characterName id=|IceSeal_Ground|/> congestion.
pal:IceWitch:
Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing.
Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much.
If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath 
under a clear blue sky.
pal:JellyfishFairy:
A Pal that closely resembles <characterName id=|JellyfishGhost|/>.
It’s very social, so when plans overlap, 
it asks its good friend <characterName id=|JellyfishGhost|/> to go in its place.
As thanks, one date.
pal:JellyfishGhost:
A Pal that closely resembles <characterName id=|JellyfishFairy|/>.
It sometimes appears as a substitute when <characterName id=|JellyfishFairy|/> is unavailable.
Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.
pal:JetDragon:
Watches over Palpagos Island from high above.
When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, 
and the skies will burn.
It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.
pal:KabukiMan:
At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings.
Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, 
and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.
pal:Kelpie:
Its personality changes depending 
on the quality of the water it was born into.
<characterName id=|Kelpie|/> born into polluted waters are generally 
ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.
pal:Kelpie_Fire:
Its personality changes depending 
on the temperature of the water it was born into.
<characterName id=|Kelpie|/> born in warm waters generally have 
a passionate, motivated personality.
pal:KendoFrog:
Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life.
By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch,
they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.
pal:KendoFrog_Dark:
The <characterName id=|KendoFrog|/> who have forsaken their honor gather and form splinter groups.
They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey.
If you encounter a pack of <characterName id=|KendoFrog_Dark|/> in the dead of the night, 
it's your life that's on the line.
pal:KingAlpaca:
<characterName id=|Alpaca|/> serve this Pal.
Contests between <characterName id=|KingAlpaca|/> offer up their vassals as a wager.
Those seen alone are losers of such contests.
pal:KingAlpaca_Ice:
With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions.
A solitary individual is pitiable,
seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a <characterName id=|Alpaca|/>.
pal:KingBahamut:
Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption.
A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon
the back of a giant <characterName id=|KingBahamut|/>.
pal:KingBahamut_Dragon:
Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth.
With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy,
it burned the entire island until nothing remained.
It was known as the Eternal Flame.
pal:KingSunfish:
Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. 
Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, 
it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.
pal:KingSunfish_Thunder:
Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. 
Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, 
it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.
pal:KingWhale:
The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart.
Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, 
its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.
pal:Kirin:
It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, 
and thus was not hunted by people.
However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike,
its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.
pal:Kirin_Ice:
It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, 
and thus was not hunted by people. 
However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, 
its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.
pal:Kitsunebi:
It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born
and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally.
<characterName id=|Kitsunebi|/> sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.
pal:Kitsunebi_Ice:
It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born
and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. 
When <characterName id=|Kitsunebi_Ice|/> catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, 
making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.
pal:LanternButler:
Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world.
If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.
pal:LavaGirl:
When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears.
The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, 
causing it to get hotter and hotter.
The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.
pal:LazyCatfish:
When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines.
Even if it were sliced from head to tail,
it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.
pal:LazyCatfish_Gold:
Its body reflects light with astounding clarity.
Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than <characterName id=|LazyCatfish|/>.
pal:LazyDragon:
Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious.
It perceives everything in its sight as prey
and will stop at nothing to devour it.
pal:LazyDragon_Electric:
One day, <characterName id=|LazyDragon|/> had an idea.
Maybe it was about time for a change.
Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!
pal:LeafMomonga:
When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s <characterName id=|LeafMomonga|/>'s approach to fixing things.
With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.
pal:LeafPrincess:
In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island.
<characterName id=|FlowerRabbit|/>'s hay fever is <characterName id=|LeafPrincess|/>'s fault.
pal:LegendDeer:
The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing.
No one else remains. All have been delivered.
O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness.
-The ancient text cuts off here.
pal:LilyQueen:
A docile Pal full of love. 
It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. 
It uses a full-power <activeSkillName id=|SolarBeam|/> to discipline naughty Pals.
pal:LilyQueen_Dark:
An elegant Pal full of grace. 
It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. 
Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.
pal:LittleBriarRose:
This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous.
It is friendly with <characterName id=|CuteButterfly|/> and only smiles
while a <characterName id=|CuteButterfly|/> is drinking its nectar.
pal:LizardMan:
A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance.
Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror
it will spend all day posing in front of it.
pal:LizardMan_Fire:
A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture.
Always in search of the hottest pose,
this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.
pal:LongCat:
In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today.
For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to 
elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly 
ten times its current size within the next century.
pal:LotusDragon:
Waters where <characterName id=|LotusDragon|/>s dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. 
Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, 
but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.
pal:Manticore:
While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat.
This is due to its blistering claws,
which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burned to a crisp.
pal:Manticore_Dark:
While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat.
This is due to its dark claws,
which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.
pal:MimicDog:
There was once a tradition of handing out an award
to the person who met their end in the most foolish way.
The first award was given for
|being unaware of <characterName id=|MimicDog|/>, opening the chest, and being bitten to death.|
pal:Monkey:
Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons.
After coming into contact with humans, however,
it found something slightly more effective: guns.
pal:Monkey_Fire:
Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. 
When its gun runs out of ammo,
it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.
pal:MonochromeQueen:
Joy and misery come in equal measure for <characterName id=|MonochromeQueen|/>. 
Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.
pal:MoonChild:
At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, 
glowing with the weight of its memories.
pal:MoonQueen:
The object floating behind, resembling the moon,
is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation.
No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.
pal:MopBaby:
Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter.
After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition.
By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!
pal:MopKing:
While hibernating, a large number of <characterName id=|MopBaby|/>
hide within its voluminous body hair.
The most ever recorded is 101.
pal:Mothman:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, and for what purpose, <characterName id=|Mothman|/> does not know.
After all, the World Tree will tell it everything. 
The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.
pal:MummyPal:
The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic.
However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, 
so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.
pal:MushroomDragon:
Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance.
Sometimes, if <characterName id=|MushroomDragon|/> appears motionless,
it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom,
but rather because it's high off its own spores.
pal:MushroomDragon_Dark:
The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight.
Sometimes, if <characterName id=|MushroomDragon_Dark|/> appears motionless,
it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom,
but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.
pal:MushroomLady:
It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts.
The reason <characterName id=|MushroomLady|/> has taken this form is to deceive humans 
into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.
pal:Mutant:
It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes.
Those seen with a <characterName id=|Mutant|/> are in its mind,
simply under its control.
pal:MysteryMask:
The mask it wears is not its face, they say.
It seems in front, but it's not there, no way.
From shadows deep, it watches night and day.
Glance away, and closer it will stray.
pal:NaughtyCat:
<characterName id=|NaughtyCat|/>'s eyes light up the moment
anyone enters its territory.
This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.
pal:NegativeKoala:
It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face,
but it is in fact kindhearted.
Some have seen it feeding <characterName id=|CuteFox|/> who have strayed from their pack.
pal:NegativeOctopus:
It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. 
Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact 
<characterName id=|NegativeOctopus|/> victims.
pal:NegativeOctopus_Neutral:
It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood. 
When two <characterName id=|NegativeOctopus_Neutral|/>s latch onto each other, 
they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.
pal:NightBlueHorse:
It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane.
If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. 
Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids <characterName id=|BlueThunderHorse|/> at all costs.
pal:NightBlueHorse_Neutral:
It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane.
If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified 
it can't focus on running properly. 
Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much,
even by its favorite Pal Tamer.
pal:NightFox:
If you find <characterName id=|NightFox|/> hair in your bedding, you should 
leave it where it lays and leave immediately. 
Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.
pal:NightLady:
Without existing, she quietly gazed upon the world.
One day, she was seized with a longing to be seen.
With unbridled lust for vengeance against reality,
thus was born the Eclipsed Siren.
pal:NightLady_Dark:
With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed.
She longed for a self to gaze upon herself. 
And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, 
were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.
pal:OctopusGirl:
Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal.
Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys.
One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some 
truly awkward misunderstandings.
pal:OctopusGirl_Neutral:
Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal.
Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks.
One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some 
truly unnecessary concern.
pal:OniGhostGirl:
It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening.
As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness,
<characterName id=|OniGhostGirl|/> now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.
pal:PandaGirl:
To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline:
Daily training is the only way!

Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable!
Daily discipline is the only way!

The time has come! Shoot my shot!
Instant rejection, that’s all there is!

The techniques of love were never passed down...
Lingering regret, that’s all there is!
pal:Penguin:
The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared,
but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever.
Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.
pal:Penguin_Electric:
The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly.
Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy—
so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.
pal:PinkCat:
At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly.
Being toyed with by a <characterName id=|PinkCat|/>
is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.
pal:PinkLizard:
Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around.
At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years
even humans have become the target of its debauchery.
pal:PinkRabbit:
A Pal that's never without a bright smile.
Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by <characterName id=|PinkCat|/>'s pranks.
During those moments, its expression turns demonic.
pal:PinkRabbit_Grass:
Always wears a cheerful smile.
Sometimes, thanks to <characterName id=|PinkCat|/>'s pranks, 
they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out!
Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.
pal:PlantSlime:
A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. 
It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover 
its body with, eventually rotting away.
pal:Plesiosaur:
Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance 
that pollinates any plant it touches. 
For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.
pal:PoseidonOrca:
After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. 
It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. 
For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.
pal:PurpleSpider:
Extremely sticky and clingy.
The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes.
Such is its |personality.|
pal:QueenBee:
A chosen queen to rule over <characterName id=|SoldierBee|/>s. 
There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death 
for the pleasure of serving their queen.
pal:RaijinDaughter:
Often kind to lonely Pals.
However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship,
it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.
pal:RaijinDaughter_Water:
Often kind to lonely Pals, 
it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down.
Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.
pal:RedArmorBird:
Some think it is a related species to <characterName id=|ThunderBird|/>, but there is in fact no connection.
It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its
beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.
pal:RedFlowerBird:
While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers 
swaying in the wind and avoid predators, 
others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.
pal:RobinHood:
A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests.
It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are
and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.
pal:RobinHood_Ground:
A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas.
When <characterName id=|RobinHood_Ground|/> bones are found in ruins,
there are always human bones found nearby as well.
pal:RockBeast:
It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape.
Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.
pal:RockBeast_Ice:
It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape.
Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.
pal:Ronin:
Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation.
If someone other than a <characterName id=|Ronin|/> wields this blade, the soul within
torments them until they are driven mad.
pal:Ronin_Dark:
Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation.
If the <characterName id=|Ronin|/> who inherits it has a weak heart, 
the voices of the dead will drive it mad.
The madness turns it into <characterName id=|Ronin_Dark|/> that endlessly wanders.
pal:SaintCentaur:
Once one with <characterName id=|BlackCentaur|/>.
Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions.
However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.
pal:SakuraSaurus:
Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing.
It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner,
which is called the |Fragrance of First Love.|
pal:SakuraSaurus_Water:
Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing.
It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner,
which is called the |Perfume of Purity.|
pal:SamuraiDog:
<characterName id=|SamuraiDog|/> territorial disputes begin with a staredown 
and end in a single, quick strike. 
Training them to |stay| is risky business, 
as the |go| command triggers that same attack instinct.
pal:ScorpionMan:
It has about 5,000 types of venom.
Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death,
but none are present in a high enough concentration to have any effect.
pal:ScorpionMan_Electric:
It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. 
However, the current it generates is extremely weak,
so a simple punch would do far more damage.
pal:Sekhmet:
Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death.
When <characterName id=|Anubis|/> claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine.
Before long, <characterName id=|Sekhmet|/> became a symbol of high nobility.
pal:Serpent:
Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water.
Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.
pal:Serpent_Ground:
Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand.
Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.
pal:SharkKid:
Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal.
However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land.
Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller
and is now a small and puny Pal.
pal:SharkKid_Fire:
Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal.
However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land.
Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power 
to control fire!
pal:SheepBall:
A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down.
This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, 
making it easy to capture and kill.
As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom 
of the food chain itself.
pal:SifuDog:
Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. 
After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects.
It ate too much today.
pal:SkyDragon:
Sleeping while cuddling a <characterName id=|SkyDragon|/> is said to be a heavenly experience,
but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones
that toss and turn in their sleep.
pal:SkyDragon_Grass:
When you hug <characterName id=|SkyDragon_Grass|/>,
if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny.
If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.
pal:SleeveRabbit:
It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, 
always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained.
Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, 
kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.
pal:SmallArmadillo:
A decade ago, <characterName id=|SmallArmadillo|/> soccer was popular. 
However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from 
the Free Pal Alliance. 
Nevertheless, the <characterName id=|SmallArmadillo|/>'s themselves didn't mind 
because it helped shed their old carapace.
pal:SmallYeti:
“To look at a <characterName id=|SmallYeti|/>'s eyes” 
is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. 
Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed 
whether <characterName id=|SmallYeti|/>s have eyes in the first place.
pal:SnakeGirl:
Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head.
However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.
pal:SnowPeafowl:
So precise is its sense of time that 
it awakens at the exact same hour every morning.
According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because
when <characterName id=|SnowPeafowl|/> spreads its tail feathers wide,
it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.
pal:SnowTigerBeastman:
The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it.
For <characterName id=|SnowTigerBeastMan|/> the toughest challenge, after simply living,
is making a snowman.
pal:SoldierBee:
A servant that pledges loyalty to <characterName id=|QueenBee|/>. 
Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. 
It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.
pal:StuffedShark:
It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, 
but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. 
In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. 
Perhaps the universe itself lies within.
pal:StuffedShark_Fire:
Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going.
Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher 
tried climbing in like a sleeping bag.
But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... 
it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.
pal:SumoDog:
In the old islands, <characterName id=|SumoDog|/> sumo was widely enjoyed.
At the highest levels, even a charging <characterName id=|Boar|/> would be sent flying instead.
pal:Suzaku:
It was once believed to usher in the dry season.
Whenever there was a drought the previous year, 
people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers,
hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.
pal:Suzaku_Water:
It was once believed to usher in the rainy season.
Whenever there was a flood the previous year, 
people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers,
hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.
pal:SweetsSheep:
Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar.
Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves 
overwhelmed by sweetness
and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.
pal:SweetsSheep_Ground:
Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. 
Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.
pal:SwordCutlassfish:
A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body 
and uses its bones to slice through enemies, 
at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long.

While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated 
in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.
pal:SwordCutlassfish_Fire:
A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long.

While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.
pal:TentacleTurtle:
To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. 
Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. 
Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.
pal:TentacleTurtle_Ground:
To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. 
With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, 
it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.
pal:ThiefBird:
A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking.
No reason to be concerned when caught in the act.
Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.
pal:ThunderBird:
Some think it is a related species to <characterName id=|RedArmorBird|/>, 
but there is in fact no connection.
Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion
that resembles a bolt of lightning.
pal:ThunderBird_Ice:
Perfectly adapted to colder environments, 
it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form.
Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, 
as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.
pal:ThunderDog:
At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning.
When two <characterName id=|ThunderDog|/>s collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air.
pal:ThunderDog_Ice:
Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard,
leading to constant <characterName id=|ThunderDog_Ice|/> collisions due to zero visibility.
pal:ThunderDragonMan:
It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. 
Fights between <characterName id=|ThunderDragonMan|/> end in the blink of an eye.
pal:ThunderFluffyBird:
With so little to eat at high altitudes, 
it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains.
It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source 
descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into <characterName id=|ThunderBird|/>.
pal:TropicalOstrich:
Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance.
In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses.
Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance!
Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?
pal:Umihebi:
Legend says the <characterName id=|Umihebi|/> was once a wise man who,
after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool,
returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.
pal:Umihebi_Fire:
Legend says the <characterName id=|Umihebi_Fire|/> was once a warrior who,
after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano,
returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.
pal:VenusFlytrap:
Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. 
However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.
pal:VioletFairy:
The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers.
A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle.
Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared.
- From the fairy tale, |The King's Flower.|
pal:VolcanicMonster:
Magma-like blood runs throughout its body.
If a large amount of water is thrown on it, the water rapidly heats,
causing an immense vapor explosion.
pal:VolcanicMonster_Ice:
Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. 
If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, 
causing an immense vapor explosion.
pal:VolcanoDragon:
In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. 
However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, 
eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.
pal:VolcanoDragon_Ice:
In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. 
However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, 
eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, 
abrupt death from shock.
pal:WeaselDragon:
It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. 
Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated 
<characterName id=|WeaselDragon|/> as they grazed to produce butter 
using this spinning force.
pal:WeaselDragon_Fire:
It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. 
Sparks also fly when it feels excited. 
If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally!
pal:Werewolf:
The horns on its head grow under the moonlight.
It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns
itch when sunlight hits them.
pal:Werewolf_Ice:
The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts.
Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite,
but both the one who tries it and <characterName id=|Werewolf_Ice|/> end up with a headache.
pal:WhiteAlienDragon:
Consumes information and turns it into energy.
Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.
- Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.
pal:WhiteDeer:
Ancient texts refer to it as the |Beast of Salvation.| 
The light emitted by <characterName id=|WhiteDeer|/> purifies everything,
literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.
pal:WhiteDeer_Dark:
Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born.
It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be.
Balance is what the world requires.
pal:WhiteMoth:
A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers
until the weather clears up.
On rainy days, <characterName id=|Kitsunebi|/> can often be found taking shelter beneath it.
pal:WhiteMoth_Neutral:
A Pal that loves gazing into the void, 
and will often remain completely still. 
It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.
pal:WhiteShieldDragon:
The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties.
If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it.
When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, 
and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.
pal:WhiteTiger:
It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws.
However, its short legs make it difficult to descend,
often leaving it stranded in high places.
pal:WhiteTiger_Ground:
It can easily carry many items with its large hands. 
However, its short legs slow its pace, 
often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.
pal:WindChimes:
Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron.
As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals
would be strung up in a public square, and a <characterName id=|Windchimes|/>
would tear the skin right from their bones.
pal:WindChimes_Ice:
Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice.
There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square
and had their hair torn out by <characterName id=|Windchimes_Ice|/>
as a brutal form of public humiliation.
pal:Windchimes:
Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron.

pal:WingGolem:
Can be disassembled into 215 parts. 
It is capable of being reassembled and functioning again 
even if the parts are scattered.
Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger 
a malfunction due to mistaken identity.
pal:WingGolem_Fire:
Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. 
Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger 
a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.
pal:WizardOwl:
Often lost in thought, it sometimes
finds it difficult to sleep.
|I think, therefore I am.|
pal:WoolFox:
Compared to <characterName id=|SheepBall|/>, it has finer wool
and a temperament more suited for domestication.
However, it has historically always been kept as a pet.
Cuteness is considered a virtue.
pal:WorldTreeDragon:
A shadow of its former self, 
this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago.
Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia 
until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer
pal:WorldTreeDragon_2:
I never wanted to hurt anyone. 
I just wanted to be together, just wanted to be there. 
But because that was forbidden... because they wouldn't forgive us...
I decided I wanted a world for just the two of us.

Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form.
In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

tech:RECIPE_ARROW:

Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_ARROW_FIRE: Fire Arrows for use with bows. Deals damage on contact. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_ARROW_POISON:
Poison Arrows for use with bows.

tech:RECIPE_ASSAULTRIFLE:
An Assault Rifle that mows down enemies with overwhelming force. 
It excels at rapid-fire and is well suited to taking down powerful foes.
Can be crafted at Weapon Assembly Line.
tech:RECIPE_AXE1:
An axe for cutting wood.
Made from stone, it's not very sharp.
tech:RECIPE_AXE2:
A metal axe capable of cutting down even hard trees.
Effective against the sturdy trees that grow deep within the continent.
Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_AXE3:
An axe that can gather Hardwood from trees found in harsh environments such as deserts and volcanic areas.
Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.
tech:RECIPE_AncientAirConditioner:
An air conditioning unit based on ancient technology that regulates the temperature of the entire base.
Smaller than standard heating and cooling systems, it maintains a comfortable temperature as long as it is powered.
No Pals are required for temperature control, and harsh climates can be neutralized with sufficient electricity.
tech:RECIPE_AncientArmor:
Ancient armor forged from Soralite Ingot.
Crafted with the essence of a lost civilization, it boasts overwhelming defensive power and is capable of withstanding cataclysmic threats.
tech:RECIPE_AncientArmorCold:
Refined Ancient Armor.
Its cold resistance has been further enhanced using ancient technology, allowing the wearer to maintain their strength even in extreme cold regions.
tech:RECIPE_AncientArmorHeat:
Refined Ancient Armor.
Its heat resistance has been further enhanced using ancient technology, allowing it to endure scorching environments
tech:RECIPE_AncientArmorWeight:
Refined Ancient Armor.
It is equipped with ancient auxiliary mechanisms, allowing the wearer to carry more supplies.
tech:RECIPE_AncientBlastFurnace:
A special furnace based on ancient technology that can smelt all types of ingots.
Materials are melted with fire, then quickly cooled and solidified using ice.
It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Cooling suitability.
tech:RECIPE_AncientCookingStove:
A special kitchen based on ancient technology that can create everything from existing dishes to entirely new recipes.
It retains heat through fire and completes cooking with manual preparation, allowing it to prepare any kind of cuisine.
It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Handiwork suitability.
tech:RECIPE_AncientElectricGenerator:
A highly efficient power generator restored from lost ancient technology.
It produces massive amounts of electricity, but is prone to overheating while in operation.
It requires Pals with high-level Generating Electricity and any level of Watering suitability.
tech:RECIPE_AncientFarmBlock:
A special cultivation device based on ancient technology that harnesses the power of the World Tree to grow all kinds of plants on Palpagos Island.
Smaller than a berry plantation and suitable for indoor placement, it still follows the same cultivation process as standard plots.
It requires Pals with high-level Planting, Watering, and Harvesting suitability.
tech:RECIPE_AncientHelmet:
An ancient helmet forged from Soralite Ingot.
It is imbued with wisdom passed down through the ages, protecting its wearer with unwavering strength.
Its defensive capabilities far surpass those of modern equipment.
tech:RECIPE_AncientMultiProduct:
A special generator based on ancient technology that uses the power of the World Tree to produce all kinds of wood and ore.
Due to its complex structure, only one Pal can be assigned to it.
tech:RECIPE_AncientRelicRecycler:
An ancient civilization device that converts materials using repurposed technology from a lost civilization.
It deciphers the technology left within Ancient Relics and refines them into new forms.
A highly specialized facility designed for the efficient use of relics without waste.
tech:RECIPE_AncientSpa:
A hot spring built with ancient technology, filled with special water infused with Paldium.
It offers the highest SAN recovery of all hot springs and also restores Health.
It is the same size as a standard hot spring, and can fully heal injured Pals.
tech:RECIPE_AncientWorkBench:
A Pal-exclusive workbench that is capable of crafting any item in one place.
It cannot be used by the player, and operates at the same speed as a regular workbench.
Due to its advanced equipment, it requires Pals with high-level Handiwork and Medicine Production suitability.
tech:RECIPE_Ancient_Houseset:
Set for building bases using ancient architecture. 
Allows building of ancient-styled foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
tech:RECIPE_Ancient_MedicalPalBed:
A ulitmate Pal Bed made from ancient recovery pod with soft matress.
It offers one of the highest SAN recovery rates of all Pal beds, quickly relieving fatigue.
It is the same size as a Large Pal Bed, allowing large Pals to rest comfortably.
tech:RECIPE_AssaultRifleBullet:
Ammo for the Assault Rifle and similar weapons.
Can be crafted at Weapon Assembly Line.
tech:RECIPE_BAT:
A Wooden Club for close range combat.
Can beat a small Pal to a pulp if need be.
tech:RECIPE_BOW:
Primitive long-range weapon. 
Hastily put together, it isn't very powerful.
Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_BOW3:
An enhanced bow that allows three arrows to be fired simultaneously.
By some strange mechanism, it only consumes a single Arrow when fired.
tech:RECIPE_BOWGUN:
Fires an Arrow effortlessly. 
Though it takes time to load, it delivers a powerful shot.
Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_BOWGUN_FIRE:
A Crossbow that deals <uiCommon id=|COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire|/> damage.
Requires Fire Arrow.
Requires Weapon Workbench to craft.
tech:RECIPE_BOWGUN_POISON:
A Crossbow that inflicts poison on its target.
Requires Poison Arrow.
Requires Weapon Workbench to craft.
tech:RECIPE_BOW_FIRE:
A bow that deals <uiCommon id=|COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Fire|/> damage.
Burns Pals with fire arrows, making them easier to capture.
Requires Fire Arrow.
tech:RECIPE_BOW_POISON:
Frightening bow that poisons its target.
Poisoned Pals are easier to capture.
Requires Poison Arrow.
tech:RECIPE_BaseCampBattleDirector:
Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base.
Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies or focus entirely on work whenever you like.
tech:RECIPE_BaseCampWorkHard:
You can command your Pals to work on various things inside a base.
Try not to overwork them!
tech:RECIPE_BaseCampWorkHard02:
A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure.
In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base. 
Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.
tech:RECIPE_BaseCampWorkHard03:
A monitoring station based on ancient technology, embedded with Red Paldium.
It issues commands across the entire base through a holographic interface, reducing SAN depletion in Pals.
A special wavelength surrounds the base, keeping Pals calm even in harsh working environments.
tech:RECIPE_Bat3:
A Metal Bat that works well in close combat. 
Use it to beat down anyone you don't like.
tech:RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_01:
A glider for soaring through the air.
Cheaply made, it isn't very fast.
tech:RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_02:
A glider for soaring through the air.
A mass produced commercial model, it’s decently fast.
Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_03:
A glider for soaring through the air.
With its capabilities improved, it can soar at high speed.
Can be made at Production Assembly Line
tech:RECIPE_Battle_Glider_Grade_04:
A glider for soaring through the air.
Its performance has been further improved, with increased speed and lift.
Can be made at Production Assembly Line II.
tech:RECIPE_BeamLauncher:
Fires a high-density beam that causes explosions over a wide area.
Caution is required to prevent overheating during rapid fire.
tech:RECIPE_BeamLauncherBullet:
Ammo for the Beam Launcher.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_BelieverFlagSet:
Free Pal Alliance Standard and Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner set.

tech:RECIPE_Berries_plantation:

tech:RECIPE_BreedFarm:

tech:RECIPE_BronzeSword:

tech:RECIPE_DefenseMachinegun_AutoTurret:

tech:RECIPE_WidePenetrateShotgun:
A specialized beam weapon for close-range combat.
It fires compressed energy in a wide, scattering blast.
tech:RECIPE_WidePenetrateShotgunBullet:
Ammo for the Beam Scatter.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.
tech:RECIPE_WingGlider:
A portable glider that enables flight. 
Consumes Wing Cell to propel the user through the skies.
tech:RECIPE_WingGlider_Fuel: The fuel required to power the Wing Pack.
tech:RECIPE_WoodCrusher:
Wood Dismantling Table can be constructed.
You can extract Fiber by cutting Wood.
tech:RECIPE_Wood_Gate: Wooden gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.
tech:RECIPE_Wooden_DoorWall: Can be locked with a passcode.
tech:RECIPE_Wooden_Houseset:
Set for building bases using wood.
Allows building of wooden foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.
tech:RECIPE_Wooden_foundation: Infrastructure for a base. Low durability.
tech:RECIPE_Wooden_roof: Cannot sleep at a bed unless built under a roof.
tech:RECIPE_Wooden_stair: Infrastructure for a base. Low durability.
tech:RECIPE_Wooden_wall: Protects supplies from attack. Low durability.
tech:RECIPE_WorldTreeIngot:
An indomitable alloy created by fusing Soralite and Paloxite.
A highly rare material, crystallizing the technology of ancient civilization and the power of the World Tree.
It is vital for crafting the highest-grade equipment and structures.
tech:RECIPE_tomato_plantation:
Farm for producing tomatoes.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Seeding|/>, <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Watering|/>, and <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_CollectResourcePickable|/> suitabilities.
tech:RECIPE_wheat_plantation:
Use it to grow ingredients for Bread.
Requires Pal with <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Seeding|/>, <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_Watering|/>, and <uiCommon id=|COMMON_WORK_TYPE_CollectResourcePickable|/> suitabilities.
